title: Vacancy-entity notification test asserts only dropdown close — no navigation (click -> route) assertion, despite spec requiring a navigation test for BOTH entity types
detail: Spec AC: "Add a navigation test (click → route) for BOTH entity types." The application side pins the routing decision via resolve_application_vacancy tests; the vacancy side asserts only show_notification_dropdown == False — navigation is in the test name but never verified. Lustre effects are opaque so this may be the achievable boundary, but the letter of the AC is unmet for the vacancy entity.
recommended_fix: Extract the vacancy path construction into a pure helper (like resolve_application_vacancy) and pin it, or explicitly document in the test that vacancy navigation is structurally unobservable and covered only by the preserved code path.
